title: Chono becomes the G1 standard-bearer
summary: The first G1 Climaxes give Masahiro Chono a path out of the shadow of New Japan’s established champions. Victories over his peers and international opposition establish his tournament identity.

chapters.title: Chono wins the first G1 Climax
chapters.result: Chono defeats Keiji Muto in the final.
chapters.context: Two of the Three Musketeers headline the new tournament’s climax, giving Chono the defining achievement of the inaugural edition.

chapters.title: A second G1 and the NWA championship
chapters.result: Chono defeats Rick Rude to win the tournament and vacant NWA title.
chapters.context: The repeat victory reinforces his tournament reputation and adds an international championship to the achievement.
